scores.justification: The implementation correctly uses time.monotonic() for lazy refill, caps tokens at capacity via min(), and consumes only when sufficient tokens exist — all stated requirements are met including no background thread. Edge cases implied by the task (fractional rates, clock jumps, cost > available) are handled sensibly; cost > capacity correctly returns False forever, and negative-argument validation was not requested. Code is concise, typed, and documented; the only nit is the absence of a lock for thread safety, which was not part of the task.
